answer: She asked me where my office was.
She asked me when the bus usually came.
other_correct: She usually asked me when the bus came.
instruction_problem: Two correct orders: 'usually' can go with 'asked' (She usually asked me when the bus came) as well as with 'came'. The meaning changes, but both are grammatical and natural, so a checker that accepts only one order will mark a correct answer wrong. Fix: accept both, or change the cards (e.g. drop 'usually' or use 'every day').

other_correct: He asked on Sunday if the shop could deliver.
On Sunday he asked if the shop could deliver.
instruction_problem: 'on Sunday' can attach to 'asked' (when he asked) as well as to 'deliver', so other orders using all the cards are grammatical and natural. Fix: accept these orders, or change the cards to block them (e.g. 'deliver it on Sunday' / 'deliver on Sundays').
